共同操作

A1

步骤 1：stir

A2

步骤 1：scope reaction under Figure 1 conditions

A3

步骤 1：reactivity test

A4

步骤 1：charge N-benzylbenzamide and 2a in air; add the stated pyridine charge；步骤 2：seal the tube, evacuate, and fill with nitrogen three times；步骤 3：add the stated toluene charge(s), lower into a preheated oil bath, and react；步骤 4：dilute with dichloromethane, transfer, and concentrate under reduced pressure

A5

步骤 1：charge silver hexafluoroantimonate in a flame-dried flask in a glovebox; equip the flask and place under nitrogen；步骤 2：add the propargylic sulfinate solution in dichloromethane dropwise by syringe/addition funnel；步骤 3：continue under nitrogen while monitoring by TLC；步骤 4：vacuum-filter through a silica pad using diethyl ether, collect the filtrate, and concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 5：silica-gel flash chromatography (0-30% ethyl acetate/hexane)

A6

步骤 1：charge solid picolyl amide and allenyl sulfone 2a in air and seal the screw-top tube；步骤 2：evacuate for 1-2 s and fill with nitrogen; repeat three times；步骤 3：add THF by syringe, wrap the cap with parafilm, and lower the tube into a preheated oil bath；步骤 4：stir and monitor reaction progress by 1H NMR；步骤 5：dilute with dichloromethane, transfer, and concentrate under reduced pressure；步骤 6：silica-gel flash chromatography (20-70% ethyl acetate/hexane)

A7
